propositions: Core commands across _commands/, _engine_support/, and _io/ modules currently parse argv imperatively, requiring separate docs-only argparse definitions that duplicate grammar logic
Each migrated command must route through a shared argparse factory wired via Route.parser_factory in _registry.py, eliminating parallel imperative parsing in runtime handlers
Unknown-token semantics (skip via parse_known_args vs reject with exit-2) must be preserved per command family, not normalized to argparse defaults
Global flags (--output, --quiet, --allow-secret-pattern) extraction in _cli/__init__.py must remain invariant, preceding per-command factory invocation
Parser construction must not import domain executors or optional dependencies; execution isolation must be verified such that selecting one command resolves only its factory and handler
